description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, §5.15): the first steps out of the Kings' Door onto the Kingsgate shelf - what to do first in the Old Kingdom.
text: The Old Kingdom lies open below. Toll-riders hold the Kingsgate beacon's hill: drive them off and relight it, and the Kingsgate shrine will let you grow. Your quest and its marker point the way.
